Our Story

Italian Soul, Baghdad Streets

"An Iraqi pasta concept inspired by authentic Italian flavors and crafted for modern food lovers."

Pasta IQ started as a cloud kitchen with one obsession: bring the rich, comforting flavors of real Italian pasta to Baghdad — no shortcuts, no compromises. Every sauce is built from scratch, every cup is portioned by hand, and every order is finished moments before it hits the road.

From bold red ragùs to silky white sauces, from vegetarian classics to loaded special recipes, our menu is built on one idea: pasta should hit different, even in a cup.
